content.text: In Nigeria, Ghana, and other regions facing payment processing restrictions, digital [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-how-creators-ghana-get-paid-online-complete-3|creators]] are left without viable options to sell their products. COREMERCH offers a robust [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-6|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]]-guide-github-pages-free-digital-product-4|The Full]] solution to build a crypto store without the reliance on platforms like Stripe or PayPal. This guide will lead you through deploying a store using Cloudflare Pages, ensuring you have control over your revenue and customer data.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

When traditional payment platforms fail, creators face barriers to monetizing their digital products. COREMERCH's infrastructure empowers you by providing a self-sufficient framework. With Stack 02, you leverage Cloudflare Pages and Workers to create a reliable and fast-loading storefront. This infrastructure is built on the principle of sovereignty, ensuring you are not tied to any external platform that could take your revenue or restrict your access.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your crypto store, ensure you have a Cloudflare account and are ready to utilize NOWPayments for seamless crypto transactions. Familiarize yourself with the basics of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript if you intend to customize your store. Have your digital products ready for upload, along with clear descriptions and pricing in cryptocurrencies. This preparation is critical for a smooth deployment process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by configuring your NOWPayments account to accept various cryptocurrencies. Integrate NOWPayments with your Cloudflare Workers backend, allowing automatic order processing. Utilize Supabase for your order storage, ensuring all transactions are recorded and managed effectively. Set up Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for secure file deliveries once payments are confirmed. This pipeline ensures that customers receive their products instantly after payment.
Own your infrastructure without dependency on external platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it's time to go live. Test your payment processing in a controlled environment before launching. Perform a transaction using a cryptocurrency wallet, ensuring everything works as expected. Monitor your dashboard on NOWPayments for real-time transaction updates. After confirming that all systems are operational, promote your store to your audience, driving traffic to your Cloudflare Pages storefront.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your store is live, focus on scaling your operations. Utilize analytics tools to track customer behaviors and optimize your product offerings based on demand. Consider upgrading to the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for expanded functionalities, such as improved email configurations with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC settings. This will enhance your store's credibility and ensure secure communications with your customers.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, utilize Cloudflare Pages for hosting and integrate NOWPayments for transaction processing. This setup allows you to maintain full control over your products and revenue without relying on traditional payment platforms. With COREMERCH's guidance, you can deploy your store efficiently.
Process payments instantly with over 300 cryptocurrencies.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators at the store setup stage comparing Stack 01 and Stack 02 are typically choosing between building it themselves with the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 — which covers both stacks in complete detail with full source code — or having COREMERCH deploy the complete Edge Stack under their accounts with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Both result in the same ownership structure: your GitHub or Cloudflare account, your Supabase database, your NOWPayments account, your wallet, your store. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I set up my store to accept different cryptocurrencies?

Integrate NOWPayments into your infrastructure. It supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to cater to a global audience. Configure your settings to choose preferred currencies and ensure a seamless payment experience.
What are the main advantages of using Cloudflare Pages for my store?

Cloudflare Pages offers fast, secure hosting with high availability. It also enhances performance through global CDN capabilities and provides SSL certificates for secure transactions. This ensures your store remains accessible and trustworthy.
Can I customize my store's appearance and functionality?
Yes, you can customize your store using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. This flexibility allows you to tailor the user experience and incorporate unique branding elements that resonate with your audience.
How do I ensure my customers receive their products after payment?

Utilize Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file storage and delivery. Set up automated delivery processes linked with NOWPayments to ensure customers receive their digital products immediately after confirming their payment.
What support options are available after deploying my store?
COREMERCH provides 30-day support after deployment. You can seek assistance for any issues or questions you may have during your initial setup and operations.
